desc: Slings are essential for gun fighting but a pain in the gun safe, arms room, or back seat of your car if not stowed properly - a serious potential snag hazard. The Sling Sleeve(TM) is a 5" long tube of military grade elastic that holds your sling neat and snag-free but remains ready for instant deployment. To use, thread your sling through the Sleeve and then mount the sling to your rifle. Z fold your sling taut and slip the Sling Sleeve over the bundle. To deploy" simply grab the sling and pull.
